title.roman: Job chhorna, gap aur aage ke maqsad

goal: Explain honestly why you left a job or have a gap on your CV, and talk about your goals.

phrases.text: I left my last job because ...

meaning.roman: Maine apni pichli job is liye chhori ke ...

phrases.example: I left my last job because I wanted to learn new skills.
During that time, I finished an online course.

phrases.text: In five years, I would like to ...

meaning.roman: Paanch saal mein, main ... karna chahunga/chahungi.

phrases.example: In five years, I would like to lead a small team.

phrases.text: I am looking for a place where I can ...

meaning.roman: Main aisi jagah dhoond raha/rahi hoon jahan main ... kar sakoon.

phrases.example: I am looking for a place where I can learn and grow.

roleplay.tutor_line: Why did you leave your last job?

task.roman: Sachchi wajah mohazzab andaaz mein batayein. Pichli company ya boss ki burai na karein.

roleplay.model_answer: I left my last job because I wanted to learn new skills. I am thankful for what I learned there.

roleplay.tutor_line: I see a gap of six months on your CV. What happened?

task.roman: CV mein gap ki wajah aur is dauran jo aap ne kiya wo batayein.

roleplay.model_answer: I took six months to prepare for my next step. During that time, I finished an online course in computer skills.

roleplay.tutor_line: Where do you see yourself in five years?

task.roman: Paanch saal ke apne maqsad batayein.

roleplay.model_answer: In five years, I would like to lead a small team. I want to become a person that others can ask for help.

roleplay.tutor_line: What kind of workplace are you looking for?

task.roman: Batayein ke aap kaisi jagah par kaam karna chahte hain.

roleplay.model_answer: I am looking for a place where I can learn and grow. I also like a team that helps each other.

roleplay.tutor_line: What are you doing now to reach that goal?

task.roman: Batayein ke is maqsad ke liye aap abhi kya kar rahe hain.

roleplay.model_answer: At the moment, I am improving my English and learning computer skills every day.

review_notes: Turn 1 teaches learners not to criticise a past employer. In your experience, are there other reasons for leaving that learners find hard to say politely (for example, a low salary or a closed company)?
